'''Edmund Gray'''<ref name="dt-20276">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20276 TIE Bombers The Real Deal], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 28 December 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20276/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20276/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''edmund''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.
